source.title: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, Requirements and Testing Procedures, v4.0 (March 2022); unchanged in substance for these requirements in v4.0.1 (June 2024)
source.terms: The standard's text is copyrighted by the PCI SSC and is not reproduced. Titles below are Bulwark's short paraphrases; read the standard for each requirement's wording and testing procedures.

controls.title: Secure development policies and procedures are documented and in use
Bespoke and custom software is developed securely
Developers are trained in secure development
Bespoke software is reviewed before release to find and fix vulnerabilities
Engineering techniques prevent or mitigate common software attacks
Security vulnerabilities are identified from industry sources and ranked by risk
An inventory of bespoke software and third-party components is kept
Known vulnerabilities are patched; critical ones within one month of release
Public-facing web applications are protected against attacks (assessment or technical solution)
An automated technical solution detects and prevents web attacks on public-facing applications
controls.note: Bulwark is not a web application firewall.

controls.title: Payment page scripts are authorised, checked for integrity and inventoried
Changes to system components follow change-control procedures
controls.note: Only changes made in Bulwark itself are logged.
